# S2.3 — Durable execution & recovery (C1): scoped leases, `suspend`, wakeup subscriptions + kernel-internal triggers, `compensate_run`, `verify_environment`/`verify_resume`, detached reconciliation, HLC, `HealingPolicy`, speculation floor (R-2.2.3, R-2.2.3⁰ᵇ, R-2.2.2¹)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5a.3 + §5a.2 (`R-2.2.2¹`)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/034_S2.3__durable-execution.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.2.3** · **R-2.2.3⁰ᵇ** · **R-2.2.2¹**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.2` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only

## Summary

The durable-execution item lands: the checkpoint is a **projection**
over the committed prefix (never a second store), `restore` is a
phase-resolved procedure, and the C1 machinery — scoped leases with
liveness probing, suspension, wakeup subscriptions, saga compensation,
environment verification/healing, detached reconciliation, resume
verification, HLC — is landed and AC-tested.

### `crates/hh-ledger` (new modules, all `tier-c1`-gated)

- `hlc` — `H<physical-hex>.<logical-hex>.<node>` stamps on
  continuation/child/forked runs only; plain runs carry none; seeded
  causally above the lineage anchor.
- `leases` — `LeaseScope::{Effect,Resource,Environment,Wakeup}` beside
  the writer lease; generation-fenced `lifecycle.lease.*` rows;
  `probe_holder` three-valued liveness (`host=…;pid=…;start=…`):
  same-host dead ⇒ takeover before expiry, alive ⇒ `WouldBlock`,
  off-host/opaque ⇒ expiry-gated; suspended runs exempt.
- `suspend` — refuses `OpenCommittedEffects` while any effect is
  `prepared`/`deferred`/`committed`; `lifecycle.run.suspended` then
  lease release; KP-10 completes on the next `restore`.
- `wakeup` — subscriptions, occurrences, the kernel-internal five
  triggers (`timer`, `permission_decided`, `child_terminal`,
  `effect_terminal`, `retry_due`), W-1 at-most-once claims, W-3
  `deliver_after` withholding, audited skips, KP-11 restart safety;
  Stage-4 triggers refuse typed.
- `saga` — `compensate_run`: applied compensable effects in reverse
  commit order, compensators as real effects, idempotent across a
  mid-saga crash, failure ⇒ `abandoned` + escalation.
- `branch` — `check_fork_point`/`coherent_fork_points`/
  `nearest_coherent_seq` (AC-R-2.2.4-1 shared prerequisite).
- `recovery`/`store` — `restore` enriched (recovery decision + cause,
  retry timers re-derived, suspended-lease completion, pending
  permissions surfaced, second-restore idempotent); effect fold tracks
  phases/attempts; `observed{terminated:true}` is unconditionally
  terminal (ADR-0265 D3).

### `crates/hh-env`

- `recovery` — `verify_environment_verdict`
  (`attached|reattachable|lost{cause}`), `reconcile_detached`
  (preserved child ⇒ `observed`; past `preserve_until` ⇒
  `terminated`), `HealingPolicy` + `heal_with_policy` (reprovision as a
  ledgered effect, `healed{restored, lost_items_ref}` at
  `authority = environment`, `ask`/`fail` postures, ledger-counted
  `max_heals` ⇒ `MaxHealsExceeded`), snapshot identity/restore +
  `SnapshotMissing{tree_address}`.
- `PRESERVE_UNTIL_TTL_MS`/`DEDUP_WINDOW_MS` named constants — the
  `ttl ≥ writer_ttl + grace` bound asserted per-run (AC-14).

### `crates/hh-hir`

- `speculation` — `SpeculationPolicy` + `check_override`:
  `defer_irreversible = false` refused outright, `allow_classes`/
  bounds narrow-only, conditioned rules need debt records (AC-12).

### `crates/hh-embed`

- `open_session{resume}` IS `store.restore`: in-process takeover
  carries the leaf; durable resume rehydrates `Driver::resume` from the
  persisted `leaf.checkpoint`/`leaf.arm` pair (atomic writes at every
  drive boundary), restores pending asks + the active turn from the
  durable prefix, re-verifies every env handle.
- `verify_resume` on a re-presented definition: add-only ⇒
  `lifecycle.definition.changed` + continue; removal of a delivered
  tool / budget decrease ⇒ `DefinitionChanged`, zero ledger mutation.
- `drive()` drains durable wakeups at every decision point —
  `deliver_wakeup` + `wakeup_drain` → caller-dedup'd `Cue.woken`
  (at-least-once across restart by design).
- Sealed-definition bytes persisted (`artifacts/<version_id>` → blob
  pool) — `get_artifact`/`verify_resume` survive a service restart.
- Schema: `OpenSpec::Resume.definition` added at the single source;
  artifacts regenerated (CC7).
